provenance.kind: Technical enforcement mapping; no added user acceptance criteria

publication.reason: Do not hash an incomplete draft into a published PolicyRef. Final digest, concrete tool pins, protected resource handles and policy installation require separate verification.

budget.clock: Persist one goal delivery start and absolute deadline before the first M1 dispatch. Queue/build/verification/wait/observation and repairs consume the same 120 minutes; a new Attempt or Run never resets it.
budget.deadlineAction: Stop new model/write/build/install dispatch on exhaustion; stop/reconcile already owned processes and perform authorized cleanup. Freeze the cleanup reservation before admission; this draft does not extend the budget.

roles.input: Pinned source, goal, design, public fixture expectations and scoped context; credentials never appear in model context.
additionalRestrictions: No writes to .git internals, case/rubric/fixture/validator files, protected baseline, evidence, policy or trust stores.
Model decides design/code/diagnosis; harness limits paths, budget and capabilities and preserves receipts.
No package install/network fetch or new dependency is authorized by this draft. Use pinned dependencies; missing dependencies block.
roles.runtime: One locked OpenCode runtime; exact executable/version/digest and sandbox/tool permissions must be frozen before dispatch.

roles.input: Read-only frozen candidate plus independently protected Case Pack and fixture.
roles.network: Candidate unit-test child must have network=none and no secrets; mobile verification requires its own explicit broker boundary, not an inherited general shell.
roles.authority: Candidate or Builder output cannot supply the expected values, verifier key, final verdict, proof of own foreground identity or official test implementation.
roles.publication: Only trusted verifier/broker/build/release identities may emit evidence after binding checks; no signature or Gate is generated by these preparations.

roles.input: Fixed local simulator handle and candidate/build identity.
allowedOperations: Build the frozen iOS simulator candidate with protected build settings.
Inspect/install only the exact app bytes on the exclusively leased test simulator.
Observe and operate the diagnostics path only; restore or uninstall only the owned installation.
roles.unresolved: No resource handle, executable deployment connector or OS-exclusive device lease is registered by this policy.

networkBoundary.modelProvider: Only trusted runtime credential delivery to an explicitly pinned provider/egress route; endpoint policy not frozen here. A localhost proxy port by itself is not a domain allowlist.
networkBoundary.deviceApp: Diagnostics needs no backend mutation. A login-free isolated fixture and app network boundary must be proven before UI execution; no real account/login fallback.

forbidden: Account/session stores, user id/email/phone/profile in diagnostics UI or clipboard.
Tokens, OAuth access/refresh content, cookie, credential file contents, environment dumps or whole Expo config.
Login, creating an account, logout, sending messages, publishing content, payment or other external business changes.
sensitiveInformation.fixtureData: Only explicit synthetic values; never discover/copy real account or auth state for a negative test.
sensitiveInformation.evidence: Capture only fixture-owned page/window. Do not read or overwrite the operator clipboard; require an isolated test clipboard. If unexpected personal data appears, block recording/export and quarantine the observation.

retriesAndStop.maxTransientAttemptsMeaning: 1 dispatch, zero blind automatic retries. Read-only refresh/reconciliation may inspect state; ambiguous writes remain unknown until exact operation identity is reconciled.
retriesAndStop.pauseCancelLoss: Close admission, fence stale owners, persist intent and confirm owned worker/verifier/device operations stopped before permitting another writer. ACK or process exit alone is insufficient.
retriesAndStop.repair: Preserve the failing candidate and evidence; give the model an explicit failure reason in a new bounded Attempt. Keep original acceptance, deadline and total repair count.
retriesAndStop.journal: An independent durable authorization/recovery authority is still required. A caller ownerId, local SQLite, offline SSH test or self-declared forced-command marker is not an authenticated independent authority.

actions: Stop only this Run's owned worker/verifier/runner and revoke its lease.
Restore the recorded pre-test simulator text-size and owned fixture clipboard; verify the restored values.

If the simulator was empty, uninstall only this candidate/owned runner and confirm no app or placeholder/container across one controlled restart. If replacing an authorized baseline, restore the pinned baseline bytes and verify the installed identity.
Return the leased simulator to its recorded prior power state only through the broker; do not alter the historic device or any other app by path alone.
Preserve immutable receipts, failures and unknown usage. Apply a separately frozen nonsecret retention policy; this draft does not authorize deleting audit records.
cleanup.failure: Do not mark released/succeeded on cleanup uncertainty. Keep the resource quarantined and report the remaining state.
